top_signals.title: Shipping Risks Repeating Stranded Asset Mistakes
top_signals.summary: Shipping lenders and investors risk repeating the mistakes made by Europe's electricity utilities and their financiers a decade ago, and the financial fallout could reach far beyond individual shipowners to lenders, investors, cargo owners and other supply-chain stakeholders…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: The battle for control of India’s $280bn Tata Group
top_signals.summary: Turbulent transition awaits N Chandrasekaran’s successor at conglomerate that owns Air India and Jaguar Land Rover
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Google ad phishing scam drains $550,000 from Hyperliquid user, security specialist says
top_signals.summary: In April, crypto security nonprofit Security Alliance (SEAL) said it had blocked 356 malicious Google ad URLs over a period of several weeks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
